stories.title: Making Pulse One
stories.summary: From a Blender product design to an object you can inspect on screen.
paragraphs: Pulse One began as a study in silhouette: a rounded contact head, a clean cylindrical body and a grip with a distinct visual rhythm. The original model was built in Blender, then prepared as a lightweight web asset.
An interactive view lets visitors turn the form and notice details that a single photograph might miss. A still image remains available when motion is reduced or 3D rendering is unavailable.
This is a product design. Performance, materials, manufacturing details and availability need physical validation before they can be described as product facts.

stories.title: A calmer way to explore
stories.summary: Why the collection puts clear choices and honest details ahead of noise.
stories.alt: Calm interior used in the RegenAI design direction
paragraphs: A useful product page should answer simple questions first: what is the object, what choices are available and what is still unknown. We designed the collection around those decisions rather than urgency or unsupported promises.
The visual language uses warm neutral space and a strong blue accent so the form stays easy to see. Supporting information is grouped close to the product instead of scattered across the page.
As real merchandise is finalized, photographs, specifications, prices and availability will come from the product source of truth.

stories.title: How the finder works
stories.summary: A clear way to browse the current collection.
paragraphs: The finder starts with three choices: where you want to focus, what your day looks like and the kind of routine you prefer. It then ranks the collection using a fixed set of product attributes.
Each result explains why it appeared. The answers stay on the page and are not saved as a personal profile or sent to an AI service.
The finder helps you browse forms and routines. It does not assess a condition or recommend treatment.
shopifyParagraphs: The published finder groups the six current products by their Shopify product type. Choose a type to narrow the page; the collection also has separate design category links.

questions.question: Can I place an order now?
questions.answer: Ordering is not open while product specifications, inventory and fulfillment are being finalized. You can explore the collection and design notes in the meantime.

questions.question: Are these medical devices?
questions.answer: No medical purpose, certification or clinical performance is claimed for the current product studies. The finder is a browsing guide, not a diagnosis.

questions.question: How are finder results chosen?
questions.answer: Results follow the preferences you select and the attributes listed for each form. The matching rules are deterministic and your answers stay in this page.
